risks: R1: Convex requires a deployed backend with a project URL and authentication setup. The spec provides no Convex deployment URL, no `convex/` directory schema, no instructions for `npx convex dev` (which conflicts with the 'never npx' SOP), and no `.env` configuration. Engineers will either stub Convex out or block on provisioning.

R2: The 'kindex' tool has no YouTube video URL listed (only 10 URLs for 11 tools). This will cause a runtime error or undefined behavior if the video embed component doesn't handle the missing-URL case.

R3: BrowserRouter requires server-side catch-all routing (redirect all paths to index.html). The spec says nothing about deployment target or hosting configuration. A static deploy to e.g. GitHub Pages or S3 will 404 on direct navigation to any sub-route.

R4: 'Step-by-step instructions with bash code blocks' — the actual instructional content for each tool page is not provided anywhere in the spec. There is no reference to a `howto.md` file being available, nor any content source. Engineers will fabricate placeholder content or block.

R5: 'Version badge showing the tool version' — no version data source is specified. Where do version strings come from? Hardcoded? Fetched from an API? Read from package.json files? This is unresolvable from the spec alone.

R6: 'Step number badge matching howto.md step order' — the spec references howto.md but does not include it or specify where it lives. The tool list ordering is provided but the canonical step numbers are not explicitly assigned.

R7: The 'closed loop diagram' on the home page has no specification — no image asset, no description of what it contains, no SVG source, no indication whether it should be built as a React component or embedded as a static image.
R8: Convex comments with no authentication means any visitor can impersonate any author name. No rate limiting, no spam protection, no moderation. The comment system is trivially abusable.
R9: Tailwind CSS v3 is specified in SOPs but Vite + React template with bun may scaffold Tailwind v4 by default depending on timing. Version pinning is not addressed.
R10: The spec says 'each tool gets its own accent color' but provides no color mapping. 11 engineers will pick 11 different color palettes, producing inconsistent results.
ambiguities: A1: Content source for tool pages — 'step-by-step instructions with bash code blocks' implies substantive documentation content. Is this to be extracted from an existing howto.md? Written from scratch? Placeholder lorem ipsum? The spec is silent.
A2: 'One-line description' per tool — where do these descriptions come from? No copy is provided.
A3: 'Quick-start table' on the home page — what columns? What data? No schema or content is specified.
A4: 11 per-tool accent colors — no color values, no color names, no palette constraints. 'Electric cyan' is the primary accent; how should per-tool colors relate to it?
A5: Comments section — is the 'author' field a free-text input (anonymous guestbook style) or does it imply user authentication? The Convex data model suggests free-text but the UX is unspecified.
A6: 'Animated fade-in on page content load' — what duration? What easing? CSS transition or a library like framer-motion? Triggered on route change or initial mount only?
A7: 'Subtle grid lines in background' — CSS background-image pattern? SVG overlay? What grid spacing? What opacity?
A8: Responsive behavior — no breakpoints or mobile design specified. Is the fixed left sidebar expected to collapse on mobile? Is mobile support in scope at all?
A9: The Convex schema definition file (convex/schema.ts) structure is implied but not specified. Should comments use a Convex table with explicit schema validation or schemaless documents?
A10: Logo at the top of sidebar — what logo? Is there an asset provided? Text-only? SVG? The exemplar.tools brand mark is not supplied.

A11: 'Import Convex hooks from convex/react' — the SOP says this, but the actual import path depends on Convex package version. Modern Convex uses generated hooks from '../convex/_generated/react' for typed queries. This is ambiguous.
questions: Q1: Where is the actual documentation content (step-by-step instructions, one-line descriptions, version numbers) for each tool? Is there a howto.md or other source file to extract from, or should placeholder content be used?
Q2: What is the Convex project URL / deployment ID? Has a Convex project been provisioned, or should the implementer create one?
Q3: The kindex tool has no YouTube URL. Should the video embed section be omitted for kindex, or is there a URL that was accidentally left out?
Q4: What are the 11 per-tool accent colors? Can you provide hex values or at minimum a palette direction?
Q5: What is the 'closed loop diagram' on the home page? Is there an existing asset, or should one be built programmatically? What does it depict?
Q6: Is mobile/responsive layout in scope? Should the sidebar collapse to a hamburger menu on small screens?
Q7: For the comments section, is the author field just a free-text input with no authentication? Is there any moderation or spam prevention requirement?
Q8: Where will this be deployed? The BrowserRouter choice requires server-side routing support. Should we use HashRouter instead for static hosting compatibility?
Q9: What logo/brand asset should appear at the top of the sidebar?
Q10: The SOP mandates 'never use npx' but Convex's standard dev workflow uses `npx convex dev`. Should we use `bunx convex dev` instead, or install convex CLI globally?
assumptions: AS1: Tool page content will be placeholder text until a content source is provided. Step-by-step instructions will use realistic-looking but fabricated bash snippets.

AS2: Step numbers are sequential 1–11 following the tool list order as given in the spec: Constrain=1, Ledger=2, Pact=3, Advocate=4, Arbiter=5, Baton=6, Sentinel=7, Chronicler=8, Stigmergy=9, Apprentice=10, Kindex=11.
AS3: Kindex page will render without a video embed section (graceful omission, not an error).
AS4: Per-tool accent colors will be chosen by the implementer from a visually harmonious dark-theme palette, documented in a constants file.
AS5: The comments 'author' field is free-text input — no authentication system is required.
AS6: `bunx` will be used in place of `npx` for all CLI tool invocations including Convex.
AS7: The 'closed loop diagram' will be a simple SVG/React component showing the 11 tools in a circular flow, not a raster image.
AS8: The logo will be text-based ('exemplar.tools' in the heading font) unless an asset is provided.
AS9: Version badges will show hardcoded version strings in a constants/data file until a dynamic source is specified.
AS10: Mobile responsiveness is in scope at a basic level — sidebar collapses behind a toggle on screens below 768px.
AS11: Convex schema will be explicitly defined in convex/schema.ts with typed fields matching the data model in the spec.
AS12: Tailwind CSS v3 will be explicitly pinned in package.json to avoid v4 auto-upgrade.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: `bun install` succeeds with zero errors. No npm or yarn lockfiles are present.
AC2: `bun run dev` starts Vite dev server on port 4000 as configured in vite.config.ts.
AC3: `bun run build` produces a production build in dist/ with zero TypeScript or build errors.
AC4: Home page renders at route '/' with: workflow overview text, a quick-start table listing all 11 tools, and a closed-loop diagram component.
AC5: All 11 tool pages are routable at /constrain, /ledger, /pact, /advocate, /arbiter, /baton, /sentinel, /chronicler, /stigmergy, /apprentice, /kindex.
AC6: Each tool page displays: tool name, one-line description, step number badge, version badge, step-by-step instructions with syntax-highlighted bash code blocks.
AC7: YouTube video iframe embeds render on all 10 tool pages that have URLs. Kindex page does not render a broken/empty iframe.
AC8: Each tool page has a comments section with author (text input), body (textarea), and submit button. Submitting calls the Convex addComment mutation.
AC9: Comments load in real-time via the Convex listComments query, filtered by current page. New comments appear without page refresh.
AC10: Fixed left sidebar is visible on all pages, lists all 11 tools with step numbers in order, highlights the active page, and has a logo/link to home at the top.
AC11: Dark theme with near-black background (#0a0a0a or similar), electric cyan accent color visible in interactive elements.
AC12: Instrument Serif (headings), JetBrains Mono (code), and Inter (body) fonts are loaded from Google Fonts and applied correctly.
AC13: Each tool page has a visually distinct accent color (not all identical).
AC14: Animated fade-in transition plays on page content when navigating between routes.
AC15: Subtle background grid pattern is visible on all pages.
AC16: All exported functions and React components have TypeScript type annotations. No `any` types on exported interfaces.
AC17: No file exceeds 300 lines.
AC18: React Router v6 BrowserRouter is used for routing with proper route definitions.
AC19: Convex schema is defined in convex/schema.ts with a 'comments' table matching the specified data model (page: string, author: string, body: string, createdAt: number).
AC20: `bunx vitest run` executes without configuration errors (tests may be minimal but the harness must work).
AC21: Only Tailwind utility classes are used for styling — no custom CSS files except where absolutely necessary.
AC22: All React components are functional components using hooks — no class components.
